name: My Cozy BookShop
summary:
My Cozy Bookshop is a charming blend of shop management sim and light RPG, set in a colorful fantasy world full of magical readers, curious wanderers, and plenty of books to discover & find!

When your grandma decides to retire to a tropical island to finally finish writing her book, she hands the family bookshop over to you with no room for negotiation. The only thing you do get a say in? Renaming the place and making it your own.
